propositions: Eval harnesses hard-code repository paths under docs/experiments/ and lack configurability for client projects
evals_corpus_root() must be the single source of truth for replay cache, output, ledger, and project eval-spec resolution, with default .rebar/evals and per-repo override via rebar.toml
Research corpus must be moved from docs/experiments/ to a top-level evals/ directory excluded from wheel and sdist distributions
Client projects must be able to run plan replay, fixture mining, and provider parity harnesses after rebar init and adding .rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml files
